s0601.literal: Mengyin County was re-established, subordinate to Juzhou.
s0601.idiomatic: Mengyin County was re-established, subordinate to Juzhou.

s0602.literal: On yiyou day the chaste widow Zhao, wife of the commoner Xiao Yi of Gaozhou, was honored; her household's corvée and levies were remitted.
s0602.idiomatic: On yiyou day the chaste widow Zhao, wife of the commoner Xiao Yi of Gaozhou, was honored; her household's corvée and levies were remitted.

s0603.literal: Eleventh month, on renyin day, an edict directed that Han persons, Southern persons, and Koryo persons on palace guard duty, assigned to serve at Shangdu, were not to be issued bows and arrows.
s0603.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on renyin day, an edict directed that Han persons, Southern persons, and Koryo persons on palace guard duty, assigned to serve at Shangdu, were not to be issued bows and arrows.

s0604.literal: On jiachen day the civil service examinations were instituted.
s0604.idiomatic: On jiachen day the civil service examinations were instituted.

s0605.literal: An edict directed the realm: in the eighth month of Huangqing third year, throughout the empire's prefectures and counties the worthy and capable were to be promoted; they were to be presented as tribute candidates to the relevant offices; in the second month of the following year a metropolitan examination was to be held at the capital; those selected were to be examined in person at court and granted jinshi degrees of varying rank.
s0605.idiomatic: An edict directed the realm: in the eighth month of Huangqing third year, throughout the empire's prefectures and counties the worthy and capable were to be promoted; they were to be presented as tribute candidates to the relevant offices; in the second month of the following year a metropolitan examination was to be held at the capital; those selected were to be examined in person at court and granted jinshi degrees of varying rank.

s0606.literal: The Emperor said to his attending ministers: "What We desire is to settle the common people so as to pursue perfect governance; yet without employing Confucian scholars, how could this be achieved.
s0606.idiomatic: The Emperor said to his attending ministers, "What We desire is to settle the common people so as to pursue perfect governance; yet without employing Confucian scholars, how could this be achieved.

s0607.literal: Establishing the examination to select scholars, perhaps true Confucians may be employed, and the way of governance can flourish."
s0607.idiomatic: Establishing the examination to select scholars, perhaps true Confucians may be employed, and the way of governance can flourish."

s0608.literal: Twelfth month, on xinyou day, Jamal al-Din submitted the Perpetual Calendar he had compiled.
s0608.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on xinyou day, Jamal al-Din submitted the Perpetual Calendar he had compiled.

s0609.literal: Five thousand shi of grain was distributed to relieve the destitute of Prince Ajiji's following.
s0609.idiomatic: 5,000 shi of grain was distributed to relieve the destitute of Prince Ajiji's following.

s0610.literal: Subordinate households of Qaidu and Duwa submitted; an edict directed the localities to supply clothing and provisions.
s0610.idiomatic: Subordinate households of Qaidu and Duwa submitted; an edict directed the localities to supply clothing and provisions.

s0611.literal: On bingzi day qualifications for officials' retirement were fixed.
s0611.idiomatic: On bingzi day qualifications for officials' retirement were fixed.

s0612.literal: On jiashen day an edict directed rectification of the Sea Route Grain Transport Wanhu Office.
s0612.idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict directed rectification of the Sea Route Grain Transport Wanhu Office.

s0613.literal: Because the capital had long suffered drought, the people suffered much epidemic disease; the Emperor said: "All this is Our responsibility — what crime have the innocent borne!
s0613.idiomatic: Because the capital had long suffered drought, the people suffered much epidemic disease; the Emperor said, "All this is Our responsibility — what crime have the innocent borne!

s0614.literal: " The next day, heavy snow fell.
s0614.idiomatic: " The next day, heavy snow fell.

s0615.literal: Because the people of Jiading Prefecture and Dehua County suffered disaster, grain was distributed in relief.
s0615.idiomatic: Because the people of Jiading Prefecture and Dehua County suffered disaster, grain was distributed in relief.
